cohort: The study included 1247 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants with birth weights < 1500 g and gestational ages < 34 weeks, born in 28 NICUs in Shandong Province, China.
finding: Moderate/severe admission hypothermia was significantly associated with increased mortality (adjusted OR 4.148) and a higher likelihood of respiratory distress syndrome, intraventricular haemorrhage, and late-onset neonatal sepsis.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to be related to admission hypothermia in VLBW infants.
